card: Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished illustration for a children's English lesson keepsake on a true transparent background, square canvas. Rounded picture-book cartoon, confident dark-brown outlines, simple dot eyes, friendly expressive faces, soft flat pastel colors with very light paper texture; not realistic, anime or 3D. Scene from Lesson 11 Is this your shirt?: an unnamed male teacher returns one white collared button-up shirt to schoolboy Tim after confirming ownership. Teacher LEFT, gray-brown neatly parted hair, rounded rectangular glasses, sage-green blazer, white shirt and muted golden tie. Tim RIGHT, short spiky dark-brown hair, terracotta sweater with two broad pale-yellow horizontal stripes, olive trousers. They face each other smiling, teacher's hands offering the SAME white shirt toward Tim's open receiving hands, all fingers and sleeve edges clearly visible; not two white shirts. Dave is a smaller supporting schoolboy in the center behind the exchange, curly light-brown hair, yellow top under slate-blue overalls, holding his separate BLUE collared shirt. Keep all three faces, hair, hands and both garments fully inside generous transparent margins. A subtle pale classroom coat rail in the background fades away, no text or labels. Medium close-up so the main two faces and the white-shirt exchange dominate, lower torsos may fade only below every hand and garment. No names, letters, stars, certificate frames or watermark. This is a friendly classroom, not a shop or a gift celebration.
